---
name: Feature / change
about: Propose a change. Material or cross-cutting changes start here, not as a surprise PR.
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem
What need or gap? Who is affected?

## Proposed change
What you intend to build. Note the product/Fabric boundary it touches.

## Boundary & principles
- Which public contracts does this consume?
- Does it risk any rule in `AGENTS.md`?
- Does it need an ADR?

## Definition of done
Tests, docs, compatibility note, entitlement/licence impact.

## Public disclosure check
In this public repo, keep this issue limited to the public change and public contracts. Do not
include private repo names, proprietary topology, licence-control detail, internal hostnames,
customer names, or security-control specifics.
